correctness.rationale: Identify the universal flag triangulation with the equilateral triangular tiling with increments (1,0),(0,1),(1,1), and deck lattice L={(a,b):a+3b=0 mod 13}; the quotient has precisely 13 vertices,39 edges,26 triangles, no 4-cliques, so the tiling is the genuine universal cover of a torus. Graph displacement length is ell(a,b)=max(|a|,|b|,|a-b|), from coordinate lower bounds and explicit shortest step decomposition. Exact enumeration of all L displacements ell<=4 gives only +/- (4,3), +/-(3,-1), +/-(1,4), no nontrivial shorter. Their geodesic words have 3 edges of one type and 1 other, giving 13 unoriented cycles per class. All 39 remaining 4-cycles bound elementary two-triangle rhombi indexed by graph edges. Exact separate enumeration confirmed total 78 four-cycles and histogram 39 trivial plus 13 each of 3 directions. Multiplication by 3 lifts as (a,b)->(-b,a-b), translation acts trivially on deck displacements, and -3 acts on basis A=(4,3),B=(3,-1) by [[0,-1],[1,1]]; group transitivity follows. Counting covers only 4-cycles and unit combinatorial metric, not smooth/longer loops.
